The Whispering Vault.text: You are Kael, and the abbot's study is the last lit room in a dead abbey. Mara scratches at her ledger by one stub of candle, and she does not look up.
He locked that desk the night they all left. Search it if you like. I never dared.

The Buried Keep.text: Grey light falls through the broken archway and dies on the steps below. Fresh scrape marks run down into the dark, too wide for any boot.
Something dragged a body down there. Not mine. Not yet.

The Silent Relay.text: QV-9 hums with full power, and every comm panel on the ring is dead. Vessa Rune waits at the airlock, override key in her fist.
Nobody goes past this lock while the ring is lit. Nobody.

The Tern Isles.text: Salt wind combs the tall grass above the ferry dock. Charmander's tail flame gutters, and something rustles in the green.
New trainer? The grass here bites back. Go on, find out.

The Drowned Lighthouse.text: The causeway to Grey Point is already under a hand of black water. High above, the lamp turns on with no keeper to crank it.
It lit itself again. Father never left it dark a single night. Where is he?

turns.action: I search the abbot's desk for what he tried to hide.

calls.question: Does Kael find what the abbot hid in his desk?

calls.text: a false bottom hides the vault key and the abbot's last letter; below, something knocks

narration.text: Your fingers find a seam under the drawer. It clicks open: an iron key, and a letter in the abbot's hand. "Do not open the vault. It is not asleep."
He wrote that the night they all left. Kael, put the key back.
Far below the floor, something knocks twice. Then it waits.

turns.action: I follow the scrape marks deeper into the dark.

calls.what: Twist away from the thing in the water

calls.text: the lurker lunges from the black water

narration.text: The marks end at black water. It stills, and a pale shape lunges out of it, all teeth. You twist a heartbeat too late, and it rakes your arm.
Told you! Told you it was down there!

turns.action: I cut the ring's power and slip through the airlock.

calls.what: Slip through the airlock in the dark
calls.risk: Vessa seals the lock on him

calls.text: the ring goes dark and he is through before Vessa turns

narration.text: The ring goes black. You are through the airlock before the emergency strips flicker on.

turns.action: I walk into the tall grass to find a wild Pokemon.

calls.text: a wild Pidgey bursts out of the grass

narration.text: The grass explodes in feathers. A wild Pidgey flaps up, furious, and dives straight at Charmander.
The ball rocks once, twice, three times. Click. The Pidgey is yours.
Beginner's luck. I'll take it off you on the road.
The Pidgey tears free and beats away over the dock. A single brown feather drifts down into the grass.

worldsmith.when: A storm coast of fishing towns and old lighthouses.

answer.title: The Causeway
answer.situation: A stone path runs out to the lighthouse, and the tide already laps over it. Wenna Rook waits in a small boat at the causeway's edge. Above, the great lamp turns with no hand on the crank.
answer.goal: Reach the lamp room before the tide takes the causeway

wenna-rook.name: Wenna Rook
wenna-rook.brief: The keeper's daughter. She rows out each dawn to look for her father.
wenna-rook.motive: He is the only family she has
